notes: KeelnetToken (src/KeelnetToken.sol) is a plain fixed-supply OpenZeppelin v5 ERC-20 named Keelnet with symbol KEEL and 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints 1,000,000,000 KEEL (1e27 minor units) once to msg.sender, the factory. It has no owner, no mint function after construction, no pause, blocklist, fee or burn hook, so every launch flow (factory to distributor, distributor claims, pool seed and swaps through the PoolManager) moves exactly the amount transferred. The launch deploys no application contracts.
